tasks.short: Observe melt condition and adjust the actual heating equipment

steps.what: Locate and read the current metal/heat specification and applicable heating reference in the native job view
Actually read temperature gauges, observe melt colour and current furnace/heater conditions, and determine the necessary adjustment against the specification
inputs: Actual gauges, melt and equipment conditions
outputs: Actual assessed melt condition and exact intended adjustment

steps.what: Make the existing immediate operating-readiness decision for the exact intended heating adjustment in the actual current equipment and work-area conditions
inputs: Actual current equipment and work-area conditions
outputs: Current decision to perform that exact adjustment or hold

steps.what: Actually adjust the furnace flame, torch or electrical heating unit as authorised for the current condition and observe its actual response
outputs: Actual heating adjustment and observed melt/equipment response

tasks.design: Configure original heat/specification lookup in {OPS_SYSTEM}/{DOCS}. Retain actual gauge reading, colour observation, current readiness and heating adjustment; {OTHER} means actual gauges, melt, furnace/torch/heater and physical controls.
tasks.previous_blocker: The current heat specification can require navigation separate from the actual equipment observations.
tasks.enabler_now: A native heat-linked reference view can reduce lookup without deciding or applying a heating change.
tasks.still_hard: Colour, instrument reliability and the actual equipment response require live assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The operator observes the actual melt and holds current responsibility for the physical adjustment.

ambition.what: Ease original specification lookup without automating heating control.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0-2; confirm existing specification access with the job-system owner

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a native heat/specification link can aid lookup; live melt assessment and heating control remain physical operator work.

assumptions: s1 counts actual source reading; s2 counts original gauge and visual observation. No new sensor feed, colour classifier or inferred melt state is provided for free.

s3 is the existing immediate operating decision for a real physical action, not author approval of paperwork. The intended adjustment exists in s2 first; any change to action or current conditions voids a1. Actual operating authority must match the site's existing route.

This statement's selected episode has no separate required record or written report; do not invent one after every adjustment. If an actual local melt log or supervisor send occurs, separate its actual capture/write/send and count it rather than folding it into s4.

tasks.short: Collect an actual metal sample and preserve its identity for analysis

steps.what: Read the actual sampling requirement, heat identity and current analysis request from original job records
outputs: Original sample requirement and explicit heat/request identity

steps.what: Actually prepare the appropriate sampling equipment and container and identify the actual sampling location and method under the existing procedure
inputs: Actual equipment, container and metal condition
outputs: Prepared sampling equipment and exact intended sample operation

steps.what: Make the existing current physical readiness decision for that exact sampling operation, location and actual work-area condition
inputs: Exact intended sampling operation from s2
Actual current work-area and metal conditions
outputs: Current readiness to collect that sample or hold

steps.what: Actually collect the authorised metal sample using the prepared equipment and container under the current conditions
inputs: Prepared exact sample operation from s2
outputs: Actual collected sample and actual collection event

steps.what: Capture the actual collected sample identity, heat/request association, collection time and any actual collection limitation
outputs: Actual captured sample metadata with explicit record/label mapping

steps.what: Fill the duplicate draft sample-register fields and produce the matching label from the exact captured sample metadata, leaving missing fields unresolved
inputs: Actual captured sample metadata and explicit mapping from s5
outputs: Draft sample-register entry and matching un-applied identity label

steps.what: Actually apply the identity label to the correct sample container and check the complete sample identity and draft record against the actual sample and collection facts
inputs: Draft entry and label from s6
outputs: Correctly identified actual sample and checked sample entry

steps.what: Save the checked actual sample entry in the same sample register
inputs: Checked actual sample entry from s7

tasks.design: Retain the actual sample collection and real identity capture, then use fixed {OPS_SYSTEM} mapping to populate repeated sample fields and a label. {OTHER} means actual sampling equipment, containers and the existing label printer; a person physically applies and checks the label.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same actual sample identity can be rewritten on a container label and a separate sample register.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed register/label template can reuse actual captured metadata without interpreting the sample.
tasks.still_hard: Representative collection, current physical conditions and correct sample/container association require the worker.
tasks.human_edge: The worker knows which metal was actually sampled and preserves that real association.

ambition.what: Reduce genuine duplicate sample-field entry without automating sampling or analysis.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; confirm existing sample-register and label-template access with their owner

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a fixed form/label integration can reuse captured sample identity; actual metal sampling and physical identity checking remain human work.

assumptions: This represents the statement's actual collect-sample branch, not a sum of collection and alternative signaling episodes. It uses a real existing sample register and label with observed repeated fields; do not invent a duplicate-entry baseline where a native label/register link already exists.

Actual source reading, preparation, physical collection and post-collection identity capture are counted before s6. Nothing records collection before s4 actually occurs. The label does not claim an analysis result or sample acceptance.

s3 is existing immediate physical readiness, not approval of the worker's authored paperwork. The precise sampling operation exists in s2 before the gate. Any change in operation/location/current conditions voids a1; follow the actual existing operational authority.

The same-system save is negligible minimum share1, fully retained, ungated and without author self-approval. Sample transport, an actual lab handoff or formal test certification must be separately counted if present; no such action is hidden in this ordinary entry.

tasks.short: Actually position the selected casting equipment

steps.what: Locate and read the actual job/equipment positioning reference through the existing native job view
outputs: Located original positioning reference for the actual equipment

steps.what: Assess the actual ladle, grinding wheel, nozzle or crucible and establish the precise intended placement and physical movement for this job
outputs: Exact intended equipment placement and movement

steps.what: Make the existing current physical-readiness decision for that exact equipment movement and intended position under actual local conditions
inputs: Exact intended movement and placement from s2
outputs: Current readiness to make that exact movement or hold

steps.what: Actually move and position the selected equipment under the existing operating method and current readiness decision
outputs: Actual equipment positioned for the job

steps.what: Actually check the equipment's resulting position, alignment and local fit against the intended job position
outputs: Actual verified positioning result or an identified mismatch

tasks.design: Configure original positioning-reference lookup in {OPS_SYSTEM}/{DOCS}, retaining actual planning, immediate readiness, physical equipment movement and resulting-position checks. {OTHER} means the actual casting equipment and its existing physical positioning controls.
tasks.previous_blocker: The original job/equipment positioning reference may require separate navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: An existing native job link can shorten retrieval without sensing, moving or aligning equipment.
tasks.still_hard: Clearance, equipment condition and actual alignment are local physical facts.
tasks.human_edge: The worker establishes and verifies the actual equipment position.

ambition.what: Ease reference lookup while preserving actual physical positioning.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing job-reference links can reduce navigation but do not perform physical equipment positioning.

assumptions: This is the statement's actual direct-positioning branch, not also the alternative signal-another-worker branch. The physical work and current decision are fully retained; no new position sensor or machine-control interface is assumed.

s3 is existing immediate physical readiness for an actual movement, not author approval of paperwork. The exact movement/position exists in s2 first; any movement, equipment or condition change voids a1. Map the actual existing operating authority if it differs.

No separate record or written send is present in this selected positioning episode; do not invent a completion report after every movement. Any actual required positioning entry, crew instruction or control-system command must be separately represented and counted if observed.
